defect.evidence_quote: The mere-evidence rule was overruled/abandoned by Warden v. Hayden (1967), which held the Fourth Amendment does not bar the seizure of items of solely evidentiary value. The separate Gouled holding — that entry obtained by stealth, ruse, or social pretext can render a subsequent search unreasonable — retains vitality.

defect.problem: The treatment survives in substance, but the disclosed record is point-specific while the assertion says varies_by_point=false and the built page visibly renders an unqualified Treatment: overruled label. The lake scope note says the mere-evidence rule was overruled/abandoned, while the separate stealth/ruse-entry holding retains vitality.
defect.proposed_fix: Set varies_by_point=true with point treatment for the mere-evidence rule and the stealth/ruse-entry principle, or otherwise render the headline as superseded/overruled in part rather than unqualified overruled.
